pages.text: IridescentCraft adds many mods, each with their own keybinds. This reference covers the most important ones so you are not fumbling through menus mid-combat.$(br2)$(italic)All keybinds can be rebound in Options › Controls › Key Binds. If a key listed here does not work, check there first — it may be unbound or conflicting.$(/italic)

pages.title: Movement & Core
pages.text: $(bold)W / A / S / D$() — Move forward / left / back / right$(br)$(bold)Space$() — Jump$(br)$(bold)Shift$() — Sneak / Dismount$(br)$(bold)Ctrl$() — Sprint$(br)$(bold)E$() — Open inventory$(br)$(bold)Q$() — Drop held item$(br)$(bold)Tab$() — Player list$(br)$(bold)F5$() — Toggle camera perspective$(br)$(bold)F3$() — Debug screen

pages.title: Combat
pages.text: $(bold)Left Click$() — Attack / Mine$(br)$(bold)Right Click$() — Use item / Place block$(br)$(bold)F$() — Swap offhand item$(br)$(bold)X$() — Cataclysm ability$(br)$(bold)R$() — Spell Wheel (Iron's Spells)$(br)$(bold)V$() — Cast selected spell (Iron's Spellbooks)

pages.title: Mod Keybinds
pages.text: $(bold)G$() — Origins menu$(br)$(bold)O$() — View your current origin$(br)$(bold)' (Apostrophe)$() — Curios equipment screen$(br)$(bold)B$() — Tetra toolbelt$(br)$(bold); (Semicolon)$() — Ars Nouveau spellbook$(br)$(bold)\ (Backslash)$() — Open backpack$(br)$(bold), (Comma)$() — JourneyMap waypoint$(br)$(bold)Caps Lock$() — Voice Chat push-to-talk$(br2)$(italic)Unbound keys can be assigned in Options › Controls.$(/italic)
